answers.core:
It's an improvement over the `DisplayServer` methods. Everyone doing cross-platform games would benefit from this.

Like said above, you could even add a more advanced `SafetyMarginContainer` node to core that already applies this logic, to improve layouts with an easy feature to push away from unsafe screen areas automatically, regardless of the node's sub rect within the window.

It would be so much better if game designers can just focus on working on their game layout, without having to worry about custom scripts to deal with specific problematic device features, that many would probably not even have considered. Because there's many variables to account for, this should be in core and "just work" for everyone.

title: Add (root) window's "safe area" method that works regardless of window position, device, screen ID, notch, rounded corners, etc
